The controller gate confirmed that a relative path selected the intended production ZIP, that the admitted archive and extracted DLL matched its manifest, and that the runner removed its private copy after a later setup failure. findings.actual: The probe parser stops at the first closing brace, including one inside a JSON path string. Invoke-Script also collapses repeated spaces before parsing. In memory, C:\build{42} caused JSON decoding to fail and C:\build  temp decoded to a different path.
findings.blocking_rationale: The paths in the candidate receipt decoded correctly and both artifact hashes matched. This affects portability of the test fixture.
findings.expected: The fixture preserves the selected paths when decoding the probe output.
findings.requested_correction: Preserve the raw probe output line and pass the complete text after the PROBE prefix to ConvertFrom-Json.
findings.requested_evidence: Round-trip a probe record containing a closing brace and consecutive spaces in its directory name.
findings.title: The handoff test can misread a valid temporary directory name
findings.trigger: Run the package-provenance suite with a TEMP path containing a closing brace or consecutive spaces.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: Open-ValidatedProductZip resolves the argument with Resolve-Path -LiteralPath, requires one FileSystem file, and passes its absolute ProviderPath to File.Copy. The gate recorded the selected source in the PowerShell location while the process directory held a different ZIP of the same name.

The fixture retained the ZIP and manifest from the clean Build.ps1 and Package.ps1 run before modifying its checkout. The real copy, validation, and extraction helpers produced both manifest digests. The refusal case still requires the specific UMM 0.33.0.0 reference diagnostic.

The real runner passed standalone validation and reached the injected setup failure with one private folder containing product.zip. It exited 1. The fixture observed zero private folders afterward, an empty Mods destination, and no lock marker. The runner’s catch performed the cleanup before the fixture inspected those paths.

summary.delivered_behavior: Cutscene Skip declares UMM 0.31.1 and compiles against UnityModManager 0.31.1.0 and 0Harmony12 1.2.0.1. The package checks bind the shipping DLL to its build receipt, inspect its actual loader references, and carry the caller-selected archive through validation and extraction.
